title: hariota knightii
intro: Hariota knightii, commonly known as the "Wild Yam," is a plant species native to the tropical regions of the Americas. It is a type of vining plant with edible tubers that have been used for centuries in traditional medicine to support women's health. The health benefits of Hariota knightii include relief from menstrual cramps, bloating, and other symptoms associated with PMS, as well as potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of Hariota knightii include dioscoretine, diosgenin, and other steroidal saponins that contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-spasmodic and anti-inflammatory properties.
